name: Killertunes
description:
'''Otaniyen-Uwa Daniel''' professionally known as '''Killertunes''' is a [[Nigerian]] record producer and songwriter who has produced ''"Manya"'' by [[Wizkid]], "''Motigbana"'' by [[Olamide]], ''"Baba"'' by [[Spinall|DJ Spinall]] featuring [[Kizz Daniel|Kizz daniel]] and ''"Bobo"'' by [[Mayorkun]] featuring [[Davido]].

Killertunes won the [[The Headies Award for Producer of the Year|Headies award producer of the year]] in 2019 for the song "''Fake Love"'' by [[Duncan Mighty]] and Wizkid and he was nominated for Afro hip-hop producer of the year at [[The Beatz Awards|the Beatz awards]] 2022 for the song ''"big energy"'' by [[Ladipoe]]. He also has nominations for producer of the year at the [[Nigeria Entertainment Awards|Nigeria Entertainment award]] and [[City People Entertainment Awards|City people music awards]] and a nomination for best music at the [[Top Naija Music Awards|Top Naija Music Award]].
